newsitem.title: FRANCE: ADP import traffic up 4.8 percent in August.
newsitem.headline: ADP import traffic up 4.8 percent in August.

text.p: August 1996 import traffic from the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, totalled 40,501 tonnes, an increase of 4.8 percent on the same month last year, Aeroports de Paris, (ADP) figures show.

Last month's traffic from North America, the principal region of origin for ADP imports, rose by 7.2 percent on August 1995 to 14,313 tonnes while shipments from the Far East increased by 11.6 percent to 10,802 tonnes.

Shipments to CDG and Orly from sub-Saharan Africa also recorded double-digit growth, up 11.0 percent to 3,503 tonnes in contrast to import traffic from Latin America which fell by 11.8 percent to 1,194 tonnes.
